bugs.symptom: Fresh Drive restore could fail the audit gate because the heavy acceptance test did not finish within 120 seconds.
bugs.root_cause: FastAPI TestClient was created in-process after process-pool and bridge activity, producing order-dependent shutdown behavior.
bugs.fix: Run the API self-test in a bounded isolated interpreter.

bugs.symptom: Closed bridge processes retained open stdin/stdout/stderr and live pump-thread references.
bugs.root_cause: close() waited for the process but did not close streams or join/reset threads.
bugs.fix: Close all streams, join threads and clear references in finally.

bugs.symptom: Identical matchup/goldfish tool requests produced different seeds and log hashes.
bugs.minimal_reproduction: Invoke the same request twice and compare match seeds.
bugs.root_cause: Random output-directory UUID was reused as simulation run_id, which participates in seed derivation.
bugs.fix: Derive deterministic simulation identity from engine version, tool name and request; retain unique storage paths.

bugs.symptom: Tests could modify canonical tracked engine process-state files.
bugs.minimal_reproduction: Run Phase-8.5 contract/integration tests and inspect git status.
bugs.root_cause: Test runtime used the default canonical log directory.
bugs.fix: Route test process-state writes to tmp_path and assert canonical bytes are unchanged.
bugs.regression_test: Phase-8.5 contract and restricted acceptance tests.

bugs.symptom: Protocol envelope contract started fourteen separate Python bridge processes.
bugs.minimal_reproduction: Time the protocol envelope test on commit 69a0da0.
bugs.fix: Reuse one persistent bridge and shut it down normally.
